responsibility: This definition module declares the public interface of the gm2 coroutine executive: an application-level multitasking and synchronization layer built on top of SYSTEM process primitives. It exposes opaque process descriptors and semaphores plus the core process lifecycle, scheduling, blocking, and debugging operations—InitProcess, Resume, Suspend, KillProcess, Wait/Signal, WaitForIO, queue rotation, process inspection, and current-process access—that other runtime modules such as the timer and I/O support use to coordinate runnable, suspended, semaphore-waiting, and interrupt-waiting tasks.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public declaration layer for Executive: it introduces the opaque SEMAPHORE and DESCRIPTOR types and declares the callable scheduler, semaphore, and process-control routines, but does not define the queue structures, process records, idle process, or scheduling logic that appear in Executive.mod.
